parameter.name: sources
parameter.label: Forecast Sources
parameter.description: Which source answers for which kind of forecast, written as role=source, for example solar-production=solarforecast. Roles are solar-production, temperature, cloud-cover, wind and heating-demand. Anything not named here is answered by the highest-ranked installed source.

parameter.name: staleAfter
parameter.label: Forecast Maximum Age
parameter.description: How old the newest run of a forecast may be before the system reports that it is planning on something old. Planning continues on what is there either way. There is no default: how long a site is happy to plan on yesterday's weather is a property of the site.
